expected.headline: 《Gothic 1 Remake》PS5日本下载版延期，发售日改为未定
expected.summary: Famitsu转述THQ Nordic公告称，因日本国内表达调整仍需时间，原定2026年11月24日推出的PS5下载版改为发售日未定，已预约用户将获退款。

replacement.headline: 《Gothic 1 Remake》日本PS5下载版延期，《Fami通》此前已报道
replacement.summary: 《Fami通》11月22日已转述THQ Nordic公告：因日本国内表达调整仍需时间，原定11月24日推出的PS5下载版改为发售日未定，已预约用户将获退款。该报道早于本期窗口，入包时间不是报道发布时间。

englishExpected.headline: Gothic 1 Remake’s PS5 digital release in Japan is delayed indefinitely
englishExpected.summary: Famitsu relays THQ Nordic's announcement that work on adjustments for Japan requires more time. The PS5 download originally due November 24 no longer has a release date, and preorders will be refunded.

englishReplacement.headline: Gothic 1 Remake’s Japanese PS5 delay was reported before this edition
englishReplacement.summary: Famitsu relayed THQ Nordic's notice on November 22, before this edition's window. The November 24 Japanese PS5 digital release was postponed indefinitely to allow more time for local adjustments, and preorders will be refunded. Packet collection was not the publication time.

evidence.excerpt: Famitsu shows November 22 at 15:00 JST and reproduces the delay and refund announcement.
evidence.reason: Correct the misleading chronology in the text without changing locked packet time metadata or inserting a story into an older edition.

expected.headline: 《Darkest Dungeon II》DLC“The Butcher's Asylum”试玩：独立竞技场连战模式
expected.summary: 4Gamer在WePlay Expo 2026的报道介绍了新DLC：玩家在独立模式中持续进行竞技场战斗，通过取悦观众积累资源并释放终结技。

replacement.headline: 《Darkest Dungeon II》DLC“The Butcher's Asylum”现场演示：独立竞技场连战模式
replacement.summary: 4Gamer报道了《Darkest Dungeon II》DLC在WePlay Expo 2026主舞台的演示。玩家在独立模式中持续进行竞技场战斗，通过取悦观众积累资源并释放终结技。报道提到的现场试玩属于初代DLC，并非这一部。

englishExpected.headline: Darkest Dungeon II: The Butcher’s Asylum showcases a standalone arena mode
englishExpected.summary: 4Gamer covered the DLC's presentation at WePlay Expo 2026. The standalone mode pits players against successive arena opponents, and delighting the crowd builds resources used to unleash a finisher.

expected.headline: 《Nioh 3》DLC“Bloody Insurrection”12月17日推出，完全版明年1月发售
expected.summary: 光荣特库摩与Team NINJA公布，DLC“Bloody Insurrection”将于2026年12月17日上线；含本体与两款DLC的Complete Edition将在2027年1月28日登陆PS5、Xbox Series与PC。

englishExpected.headline: Nioh 3: Bloody Insurrection launches December 17; Complete Edition follows in January
englishExpected.summary: Koei Tecmo and Team NINJA announced the expansion for December 17, 2026. The Complete Edition, including the base game and both expansions, is slated for January 28, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series and PC.
